version.description: The version of this file's format. Always 1.

name.description: A name for the project. Not used by any workflow yet.

atlassian.description: Jira and Confluence Cloud. Needed by every workflow that reads requirements.

site.description: Your Jira Cloud site, such as https://acme.atlassian.net.

email.description: The email of the Atlassian account the API token belongs to. It is personal data: prefer ${env:ATLASSIAN_EMAIL}, so it stays out of git.

token.description: The Atlassian API token, as a secret reference.

spaceKey.description: The key of the space documents are published to.

parentPageId.description: The id of the page that published documents go under. Without it, they go at the top of the space.

jira.description: How requirements are read from Jira. Every key has a default.

acceptanceCriteriaField.description: The field that holds acceptance criteria, by id or name. Default: a field named like acceptance criteria, else the criteria in the description.

extraFields.description: More text fields to read into each requirement, by id or name.

maxDepth.description: Levels of child issues read below each input issue (epic, story, sub-task). Default 3.

maxIssues.description: The most issues read in one run. Default 100.

followLinks.description: Read linked issues, one level out. Default true.

followLinkedChildren.description: Also read the children of linked issues. Default true.

maxPages.description: The most linked Confluence pages read in one run. Default 20.

xray.description: Xray Cloud, where test cases and Test Executions are written.

clientId.description: The Xray API key's client id, or a secret reference to it.

clientSecret.description: The Xray API key's client secret, as a secret reference.

projectKey.description: The Jira project the tests are created in, such as QA.

baseUrl.description: The Xray Cloud region's URL. Default https://xray.cloud.getxray.app.

priorities.description: The Jira priority name for each test priority, such as `P1: Highest`. A priority left out isn't set.

P1.description: The Jira priority name for P1.

P2.description: The Jira priority name for P2.

P3.description: The Jira priority name for P3.

P4.description: The Jira priority name for P4.

linkType.description: The Jira link type from each test to its requirement. Default Test (tests / is tested by).

attachScreenshots.description: Attach Playwright's screenshots to the tests of a Test Execution, passed or failed. Off by default: a screenshot can't be masked, so what the page showed (names, record data) goes to Xray as it is.

executionDates.description: The Test Execution's own start and end date fields, which Xray doesn't set from the results: Jira custom fields, with each field's type.

start.description: The field for the execution's start.

field.description: The Jira custom field id, such as customfield_10505.

type.description: `date` for a field that holds a day (the UTC day is written), `datetime` for a date and time.

end.description: The field for the execution's end.

field.description: The Jira custom field id, such as customfield_10505.

type.description: `date` for a field that holds a day (the UTC day is written), `datetime` for a date and time.

git.description: Your git host: read for pull request context, and used to open pull requests from CI.

repo.description: owner/name on GitHub, organization/project/repository on Azure DevOps, the project's full path (group/subgroup/project) on GitLab.

token.description: A token that can read pull requests and open one, as a secret reference.

baseUrl.description: The REST API root for a self-hosted server, such as https://HOST/api/v3 on GitHub Enterprise Server. Default: the cloud service.

salesforce.description: Salesforce sign-in for `explore` and the generated tests: the JWT bearer flow of an External Client App, one user per role. Nothing is stored: each sign-in makes a single-use URL.

baseUrl.description: The org's My Domain URL, such as https://acme--uat.sandbox.my.salesforce.com.

auth.description: How users sign in. Only jwt: the OAuth JWT bearer flow, which no MFA prompt stops.

loginUrl.description: https://login.salesforce.com, or https://test.salesforce.com for a sandbox.

audience.description: The JWT assertion's audience. Default: https://test.salesforce.com for test.salesforce.com and sandbox My Domains, else https://login.salesforce.com.

clientId.description: The External Client App's consumer key, or a secret reference to it.

privateKey.description: The app's private key (PEM), as a secret reference. Give this or privateKeyFile.

privateKeyFile.description: The path to the private key file (PEM), outside the repo, or a secret reference holding the path. Give this or privateKey.

users.description: The Salesforce username for each role, such as `StoreManager-FRA: user@acme.com.uat`, or a secret reference. At least one.

models.description: The models that answer from the CLI and CI. In an IDE, the IDE's own model answers (docs/models.md).

default.description: The model for every step, as provider:model, such as anthropic:claude-sonnet-5-5.

allowed.description: The models that may run, as provider:model or provider:*. A model outside the shipped catalog runs, with a doctor warning.

workflows.description: A model for one workflow, by workflow id, such as `scripts: anthropic:claude-opus-5-5`.

keys.description: The API key for each provider, as a secret reference. Default: the provider's usual variable, such as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

endpoints.description: The base URL for a provider: OpenRouter, or your LiteLLM gateway.

masking.description: How personal data is masked before a model sees it (docs/security.md).

restoreOnWrite.description: Put the real values back into what is written to Xray and Confluence, on an approved write. Off: they receive the tokens as they are.

detectors.description: The detectors that run. Default: all. `address` is accepted but has no detector yet.

fields.description: Fields always replaced whole, by source, such as `jira: [customfield_10042, "Customer phone"]`.

languages.description: The languages whose name lists find names that no people field lists. Default: all nine.

presidio.description: Accepted and checked by doctor, but nothing sends text to Presidio yet.

policy.description: What Agent-QA may write outside its run folder, and what it asks you first (docs/security.md).

writes.description: allow, ask or deny for each target.

xray.description: Creating and updating test cases and Test Executions. In CI, ask is denied.

confluence.description: Publishing a document. In CI, ask is denied.

testCode.description: Writing or deleting files in your repo. In CI, ask leaves the code as a pull request.

commands.description: Running the commands the framework profile lists (tests, type check) in your repo. In CI, anything but deny allows.

harness.description: Your own cases for `agent-qa harness`. Without this section, it runs the shipped synthetic cases (docs/harness.md).

jira.description: Accepted, but skipped for now: a Jira source has no known seeds to check.

sources.description: Where the cases come from: `- fixtures: path/to/cases`.

seededPersonalData.description: A file of the planted values to look for. Default: the shipped seeds.

playwright.description: A local web app, for `explore` without Salesforce.

baseUrl.description: A local app for `explore` to drive when there is no salesforce section.

testDir.description: Not used: the reviewed framework profile says where the tests are.

profile.description: Not used: the reviewed profile is always agent-qa.profile.json at the project root.

description: agent-qa.yaml: Agent-QA's settings. Secrets appear only as ${env:NAME} or ${keychain:NAME} references.
